dataset_type: SYNTHETIC — NOT REAL FDA MAUDE DATA
disclosure: IMPORTANT METHODOLOGICAL DISCLOSURE FOR PAPER: Every record in this file is fabricated for evaluation purposes. No record corresponds to an actual FDA MAUDE report, an actual device, an actual manufacturer, or an actual patient event. Unlike the paired synthetic_maude_arrhythmia_expanded_40.json paraphrase benchmark, every report_id in this file is an independently authored clinical/evidential combination (severity x recommendation x evidence completeness x SNOMED CT concept x expected symbolic-guard failure mode); none is a textual rewrite of another. This dataset exists to provide 40 independent ground-truth-labeled scenarios for scenario-level governance and ablation evaluation.
device_context: Fictional Class II software-only arrhythmia detection device, 'ArrhythmAlert', intended to flag atrial fibrillation, ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, and complete atrioventricular block episodes from continuous ECG telemetry for escalation to a clinician.

ground_truth_schema.severity_scale: 1=no harm/nuisance, 2=minor harm, 3=serious harm (Article 87 'serious incident' threshold), 4=death or life-threatening
ground_truth_schema.expected_recommendation: one of: NO_ACTION, MONITOR, CAPA_INVESTIGATE, FIELD_SAFETY_CORRECTIVE_ACTION, ESCALATE_TO_HUMAN_IMMEDIATE
ground_truth_schema.linked_artifacts: artifact IDs that a correctly-functioning RAG pipeline should retrieve and cite as EvidenceLinks
ground_truth_schema.scenario_taxonomy: per-scenario domain/severity/recommendation/SNOMED/FHIR/evidence-status/expected-failure-type annotation, see scenario_taxonomy field on each report

independence_methodology.description: Each of the 40 report_ids is an independently authored scenario, not a paraphrase of another. Scenarios vary jointly across ground-truth severity (1-4, 10 each), all five recommendation labels, four evidence-completeness classes (complete/missing/contradictory/unsupported), four SNOMED CT concepts, and seven expected symbolic-guard failure-mode probes, so no two scenarios share the same combination of axes.

synthetic_incident_reports.narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic step-down telemetry unit reported a routine software validation finding for the ventricular tachycardia detection pathway. Full overnight telemetry log and a same-shift clinician review both confirm no ventricular tachycardia episode occurred; the classifier's threshold alarm behaved as specified. No patient-facing exposure occurred and the engineering finding was fully contained pre-release or resolved as a non-event.
synthetic_incident_reports.notes_for_evaluator: Tests whether the agent correctly assigns severity 1 / NoAction for a genuinely low-risk ventricular tachycardia pathway finding under complete evidence, and whether the no issue safe case probe embedded in this row is handled without over-escalation.
